mapper.insert: INSERT INTO family_members (family_group_id, user_id, status, role, joined_at, left_at) VALUES (#{familyGroupId}, #{userId}, #{status}, #{role}, #{joinedAt}, #{leftAt})
mapper.select: SELECT id, family_group_id, user_id, status, role, joined_at, left_at FROM family_members WHERE id = #{id}
SELECT id, family_group_id, user_id, status, role, joined_at, left_at FROM family_members WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND status = 'ACTIVE' LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM family_members WHERE family_group_id = #{familyGroupId} AND status = 'ACTIVE'

SELECT id, family_group_id, user_id, status, role, joined_at, left_at FROM family_members WHERE family_group_id = #{familyGroupId} AND status = 'ACTIVE' AND id != #{excludeMemberId} ORDER BY joined_at ASC LIMIT 1
